title: LOOKUPVALUE ignores a filter on the table of the result column
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( LOOKUPVALUE ( Product[Product], Product[ProductKey], 3 ), Product[Color] = "Red" ) )

source.quote: LOOKUPVALUE removes filters from the table that contains result_columnName
source.supports: filters on the result column's table are removed, as by ALL

source.quote: LOOKUPVALUE removes the filters on the table of Result_ColumnName with ALL

derivation: ProductKey 3 is Lock, which is Blue. The outer filter Product[Color] = Red is on the table of the result column, so LOOKUPVALUE removes it and finds Lock.
notes: An engine that kept the outer filter would return BLANK.
